desc: Implement prefix DP solution in `maximumWeight`: attach 0-based original indices, sort intervals by right endpoint, compute compatible prefix counts with strict `right < left`, maintain DP states for exactly `k = 0..4` intervals storing `(max_score, lexicographically_smallest_sorted_index_tuple)`, and return the best tuple across all `k` after comparing score first and tuple lexicographic order second.

Run the current implementation against the provided sample tests and edge cases (strict boundary non-overlap, equal weights, fewer than 4 compatible intervals, and lexicographic tie-breaking across cardinalities), and report a pass/fail verdict with any failing case.
